title: Securities Industry Regulations (Commencement) Order, 2024
text:
No. 31] Securities Industry 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 31 of 2024
ORDER made by the Minister responsible for finance in
exercise of the powers conferred upon him by section
195 of the Securities Industry Act, 2021 (No.46 of 2021),
and all other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 24th February, 2024)
1. This Order may be cited as the
Citation.
SECURITIES INDUSTRY REGULATIONS
(COMMENCEMENT) ORDER, 2024.
2. In exercise of the powers conferred upon me by regulation Commencement
137 of the Securities Industry Regulations (Statutory of S.I. No. 139
of 2023.
Instrument No. 139 of 2023), and all other powers thereunto
me enabling, I, JOHN BRICEÑO, Prime Minister and
Minister responsible for finance, hereby appoint the 15th
day of December, 2023, as the day on which the Securities
Industry Regulations shall be deemed to have come into
force.
MADE by the Minister responsible for finance this 20th day
of February, 2024.
(HON. JOHN BRICEÑO)
Prime Minister and Minister of Finance,
Economic Development and Investment, Blue Economy and
Civil Aviation and Immigration
(Minister responsible for finance)
Printed in Belize by the Government Printer
#1 Power Lane, Belmopan
